# Starting out…

Starting this project hasn’t been as difficult
as the first, the starbie.

Firstly I skimmed through the README file of the guide to see the necessities of the project.

Right after, I set up my GitHub repository and cloned it to my laptop. Then I started doing my first reel for this project.
